title: sokf info formats registry
description: The registry of `sokf info formats --json`: the types and the formats of the registry that the command prints as YAML, in the shape of a formats file, each entry with its source (CLI-5_AC-38).

types.description: The placeholder types, by name, an empty map where the registry declares none.

registry.description: The line formats, by name, an empty map where the registry holds none.

FormatType.description: One placeholder type of the registry.

match.description: What the type matches: a regular expression, or a list of literal choices.

source.description: Where the type comes from: `built-in`, `embedded`, `repo`, the path of a file of `/.sokf/formats.d/`, or the id of a schema.

anyOf.description: A regular expression with no anchors and no capture groups.

FormatEntry.description: One line format of the registry: its keys as a formats file writes them, which the grammar `format` of `sokf info grammar` defines, such as `template`, `example`, and `variants`, and its source.

source.description: Where the format comes from: `embedded`, `repo`, the path of a file of `/.sokf/formats.d/`, or the id of a schema.
